Class AppConfig

java.lang.Object
com.groupxx.greengrocer.config.AppConfig
public final class AppConfig extends Object
Global application configuration.

Contains constants and settings for the application, including database connection parameters, UI dimensions, financial rules (VAT, discounts), and business logic rules (minimum orders).
